definitions.gloss: New Year's rope decoration; sacred straw festoon for New Year's
definitions.explanation: A decorative ornament made from twisted straw rope, hung on doors or gates during the New Year period to welcome the year's deity and ward off evil spirits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しめ{飾|かざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: To hang a New Year's rope decoration on the front door.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧しめ{飾|かざ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{売|う}られる→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: At the end of the year, New Year decorations are sold at supermarkets.

examples.japanese: {松|まつ}の{内|うち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎたら→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧、しめ{飾|かざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}して→外す：02394_hazusu⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧どんど{焼|や}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{燃|も}やして→燃やす：02318_moyasu⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: After the New Year's pine period is over, we take down the rope decorations and have them burned at the shrine's bonfire ceremony.

notes:
A traditional Japanese New Year decoration derived from ⟦{注連縄|しめなわ}→注連縄：06015_shimenawa⟧ (sacred straw rope). Typically displayed from around December 28 until January 7 (or January 15 in some regions). It is believed to mark a purified space for the {年神|としがみ} (deity of the new year) to enter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- しめ{飾|かざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to put up a New Year decoration
- しめ{飾|かざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to take down a New Year decoration
- ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧しめ{飾|かざ}り: door decoration for New Year

CULTURAL NOTE:
It is considered bad luck to put up しめ{飾|かざ}り on December 29 ({二重苦|にじゅうく}, "double suffering") or December 31 ({一夜飾|いちやかざ}り, "overnight decoration," seen as disrespectful). After the New Year period, decorations are traditionally burned in a ceremony called どんど{焼|や}き.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{注連縄|しめなわ}→注連縄：06015_shimenawa⟧: sacred straw rope — the base form, used year-round at shrines
- ⟦{門松|かどまつ}→門松：14522_kadomatsu⟧: pine decoration — another traditional New Year decoration placed at gates
- ⟦{鏡餅|かがみもち}→鏡餅：19469_kagamimochi⟧: mirror rice cake — a New Year offering placed indoors
